title: Sales → CS: Retrofit Health handoff — commitments, timeline, and open asks
text:
Sales → CS: Retrofit Health handoff — commitments, timeline, and open asks

['From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa@retrofithealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sales → CS: Retrofit Health handoff — commitments, timeline, and open asks

Hi Marissa / Karthik,

Quick handoff for Retrofit Health (deal RWH-2026-0927). We closed on Friday — signed MSA + PO expected this week. Key context below so CS can pick up with implementation planning.

Deal snapshot
- ARR: $420k annual commit (multi-team rollout)
- Initial scope: embeddings + chat routing for 3 product teams (Support Assist, Search, and Summaries)
- Go-live target: pilot by 2027-01-15, full production by 2027-04-01

Committed SLAs / expectations (caller requested)
- 99.5% availability for hosted API in US region after pilot
- 95th percentile latency target: <= 250ms for chat common path
- Monthly token usage estimate: 2.5B tokens 

Security/compliance notes
- They requested our Network Security Attestation and a SOC2 excerpt (attached: Network_Security_Attestation.pdf)
- Data residency must remain in us-west for pilot, long-term multi-region TBD

Open asks for CS to confirm before kickoff
1) Confirm owner for the kickoff and weekly sync cadence (we suggested Tues 10am PT)
2) Verify whether they need a private deployment (they warmed to Dedicated but procurement prefers hosted to start)
3) Review SOW draft and confirm milestone acceptance criteria (attached: Retrofit_SOW_v1.docx)

Internal notes
- Technical sponsor: Lisa Park (Head of AI Ops)
- Procurement contact: procurement@retrofithealth.com
- Discount / concessions: 3-month ramp credit included per exec approval

Marissa — can you take ownership of the kickoff and assign a steady-state CSM? Karthik, please review the SOW milestones and call out any implementation constraints you foresee.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Retrofit_SOW_v1.docx (docx), Network_Security_Attestation.pdf (pdf)
', 'From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa@retrofithealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: Retrofit Health handoff — commitments, timeline, and open asks

Thanks Sean — congrats on the close. I’ll own kickoff + weekly syncs.

Karthik — would you be the technical lead on the implementation? If so, I’ll assign you as the implementation PM and loop in onboarding engineering for the initial architecture call.

Pre-kickoff plan (proposed)
- Internal prep: review SOW + security packet (today/tomorrow)
- Kickoff #1 (intro + architecture): Wed 2026-10-21, 10:00am PT (30–45m) — Sean: please confirm Lisa’s availability
- Kickoff #2 (detailed milestones & acceptance criteria): Mon 2026-10-26, 10:00am PT (60m)

Open items I’ll own before kickoff:
- Finalize weekly sync invite + stakeholder roster
- Confirm whether we start hosted or provision dedicated capacity for pilot
- Request sample data slices for integration testing (PII-scrubbed)

Karthik — if you can post comments on the SOW by EOD Tue, I’ll incorporate and send an updated SOW to Lisa + procurement for review.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
', 'From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa@retrofithealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: Retrofit Health handoff — commitments, timeline, and open asks

Marissa — I can lead the implementation as technical PM. High-level notes after quick scan of SOW: 

SOW / implementation observations
- Milestone 1 (Pilot environment): needs explicit acceptance test for latency under 250ms using their sample traffic; we should add the exact query profile for the test (I can draft)
- Milestone 2 (Embedding migration): clarify whether embeddings will be served from our hosted index or their managed vector DB — that changes integration timeline by ~2–3 weeks
- Auth & keys: they want rotation policy documented; recommend we offer KMS integration during pilot (optional)

Pre-kickoff asks for Retrofit
- Can Lisa share a 72-hour sample of anonymized query logs (CSV) so we can size batching/kv cache settings?
- Confirm whether the Support Assist team needs realtime streaming responses (they noted sub-200ms as a stretch)

I’ll attach a redlined SOW (first pass) and a simple acceptance-test matrix before the Wed intro.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: Retrofit_SOW_v1_redline.docx (docx)', 'From: Lisa Park <lisa@retrofithealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: Retrofit Health handoff — commitments, timeline, and open asks

Marissa / Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and congrats team. Wed 10am PT works for the intro. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We prefer hosted to start for procurement speed, but please prepare a dedicated capacity estimate for our cloud team in case we need to switch after pilot.
- I’ll share the anonymized 72-hour logs by EOD Tue (will strip PII).
- For acceptance tests: happy to run the latency profile you draft; Support Assist will prioritize throughput over lowest-possible latency for phase 1.
- Procurement: I’ll push the PO this week; expect an exec signature next Tue.

Looking forward — see you on Wed.

Lisa Park
Head of AI Ops
Retrofit Health

Forwarded attachments: Retrofit_SOW_v1.docx, Network_Security_Attestation.pdf
